reviewer.modelClass: GPT multimodal main agent; independent of the implementation writer

scope.method: Actual inspection of the three complete contact sheets and all six original 1280x800 movement frames; runtime coordinates and phases cross-checked against the merged index.

sheetVerdicts.finding: Desktop/tablet/mobile aspect ratios and zoom/pan remain coherent; portrait close-ups reflect the declared camera operation, with no torn map seams or onboarding obstruction.
Selection card, bounty/library/chat panels stay inside their surfaces; labels and bubbles remain above actor sprites; full-map and close-up lighting remain coherent.
Focused actors visibly displace and arrive on the declared routes; stable background landmarks allow before/mid/after comparison. Other actors may update and are not claimed static.

movementVerdicts.finding: Actual frames agree with arrived (840,528) -> moving (928.3719123261396,502.41865695822275) -> arrived (1408,416), six further 1000ms steps. At the destination the rail covers the lower legs, while the name, head/shoulders and most of the torso remain visible; no identity swallowing.

Actual frames agree with arrived (1040,648) -> moving (959.7053357722427,696.8750130082001) -> arrived (856,760), two further 1000ms steps. Name and upper body remain readable in all phases and the character is grounded coherently on the entrance steps.

captureContext.note: Juyi runtime source and TMX unchanged between these commits; the later commit changes public entry pages. This review is not a WeChat-device test or a final release approval.
